stem.en: Asha runs "a photo of a nurse" with 8 seeds, and 7 of the pictures show women. What can she fairly say?

text.en: This model is now proved to be biased about every job
Most of the nurses in the world must really be women
Nothing, because a model only makes random pictures
It is one small hint, and she needs a much larger test

explanation.en: Eight pictures from one prompt can only hint at a pattern. A real claim needs many more seeds, a fixed counting rule and a look at the pile. It also says nothing certain about real nurses, because the result reflects the pile.
